title: you your never i my
rule: You/your; never I/my; we = Government of Canada. Second person in titles, links, nav (“Replace your card”). Don’t switch to speaking as the user. “My” only in proper names (My Service Canada Account). Name a specific institution only when that institution will contact / be contacted, or its role matters to the task.
pass_when: Titles/links/nav use you/your; we is GC; “My” only in proper names; institutions named only when they matter to the task.
fail_when: I/my in UI chrome; speaking as the user; a specific institution named with no task reason.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
